import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import unreal
root = Path(unreal.Paths.project_dir()).resolve()
assert root.as_posix().casefold() == 'd:/project/rogue10m'
package_name = '/Game/Widget/Debug/WBP_ClassBottomHUDShowcase'
relative = 'Content/Widget/Debug/WBP_ClassBottomHUDShowcase.uasset'
manifest = json.loads((root/'Feature/doc/evidence/split-hud-20261014/assets-before.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
before_hash = hashlib.sha256((root/relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert before_hash == manifest[relative]['sha256']
dirty = list(unreal.EditorLoadingAndSavingUtils.get_dirty_content_packages())
assert not unreal.EditorLoadingAndSavingUtils.get_dirty_map_packages()
assert {p.get_name() for p in dirty} == {package_name}, [p.get_name() for p in dirty]
# Recompiling the owned Bottom BP marked this dependent preview dirty in this
# fresh task-owned editor. Restore its unchanged disk version without saving it.
result = unreal.EditorLoadingAndSavingUtils.reload_packages(dirty,unreal.ReloadPackagesInteractionMode.ASSUME_POSITIVE)
assert hashlib.sha256((root/relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == before_hash
report = {'package': package_name, 'reload_result': str(result), 'disk_sha256_preserved': before_hash,
          'dirty_after': [p.get_name() for p in unreal.EditorLoadingAndSavingUtils.get_dirty_content_packages()]}
(root/'Feature/doc/evidence/split-hud-20261014/dependent-preview-reload.json').write_text(
    json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False))
